## Context / Problem
The anthropic cache breakpoint sits on the WHOLE system block (`anthropic_cache_instructions=True`, src/rebar/llm/anthropic_model.py:39-52), so only byte-identical full system prompts share a cache entry. The Pass-2 verifier currently places the plan in the USER message, so its system block gets no plan-bearing cache benefit at all; moving the plan into the verifier's system prompt enables (a) within-pass reuse across the verifier's chunked calls (every chunk of one verify step shares one identical system prompt → one cache entry, written once and read per chunk) and (b) cross-run reuse strictly within Anthropic's ephemeral cache TTL (~5 min) — a best-effort bonus for rapid re-verifies of an unchanged plan, not a reliability guarantee. Byte-identity of the shared leading prefix across Pass-1 and both verifier prompts is enforced as a SINGLE-SOURCE STRUCTURAL INVARIANT (one code seam emits the prefix) — it positions the prompts for provider-side prefix reuse and prevents drift, but the plan does NOT claim it creates a shared cache entry between finder and verifier within one run (those system prompts still differ past the prefix under the whole-block breakpoint). Today the two passes render through different paths with no shared plan-bearing prefix: Pass-1 finder builds its system prompt via `passes._resolve_system` (src/rebar/llm/plan_review/passes.py:276-292) = `_SHARED_PREAMBLE` (passes.py:264) + the rendered finder template, whose `{{plan}}` sits at the template END (src/rebar/llm/reviewers/plan_review_finder.md:30-31, no volatile marker); Pass-2 verify runs via the workflow `RunnerAgentStep` (src/rebar/llm/workflow/runs.py:245) → `prompts.resolve_prompt_cached` (src/rebar/llm/prompting/prompts.py:380-405), which splits at the `<!--volatile-->` marker (plan_review_verifier.md:173 / plan_review_verifier_agentic.md:181 — the agentic arm is the primary production path) and routes the rendered `{{plan}}` into the USER message; the per-run finding listing arrives separately as `base_instructions` (the `instructions` output of `plan_review_verify_inputs`, src/rebar/llm/plan_review/workflow_ops.py:363-395). So the Pass-2 system prompt never contains the plan, and no plan-bearing prefix is shared across passes. The codebase's cache floor is `CACHE_MIN_PREFIX_TOKENS = 4096` (src/rebar/llm/plan_review/pass1.py:49 — the Opus 4.8 minimum used by the warmup logic at pass1.py:222,496), which this change adopts as its threshold (NOT the older 1024 figure). Separately, incremental-depth BLOCK loops need an exhaustiveness directive in the shared reviewing stance.

## Approach
Byte identity by construction, single-sourced in code — no template gains a variable that any renderer cannot supply.
(1) **`prompts.py` gains the single source**: a module constant `SHARED_STANCE_PREAMBLE` (the text of `passes._SHARED_PREAMBLE`, moved verbatim, PLUS one new bullet — the exhaustiveness directive: "When surfacing findings, enumerate EVERY independent defect you find in THIS run; do not defer deeper or additional findings to a later review round.") and `shared_plan_prefix(plan: str) -> str` returning `SHARED_STANCE_PREAMBLE + "# Plan under review (verbatim, whole)\n" + plan + "\n\n"`. Placement rationale: passes.py is at 798/800 LOC (the hard cap) and cannot absorb the builder; prompts.py is the natural home because it already owns the `VOLATILE_MARKER`/`split_volatile`/`resolve_prompt_cached` cache-prefix seam that `shared_plan_prefix` extends (prompts.py:349-405), and it stays stdlib-only.
(2) **Pass-1 rule, exact**: `passes._SHARED_PREAMBLE` is DELETED. `_resolve_system(prompt_id, plan, cfg)` renders the template with variables `{"plan": plan, "shared_prefix": prompts.shared_plan_prefix(plan)}` (strict rendering only requires USED variables — prompts.py:321-330 — so the superset is harmless to every template), then returns `prompts.shared_plan_prefix(plan) + strip_volatile_marker(rendered)` when `prompt_id == PASS_FINDER`, else `prompts.SHARED_STANCE_PREAMBLE + strip_volatile_marker(rendered)` (byte-equal to today's behavior, modulo the added directive bullet, for EVERY else-branch caller, enumerated: container, ISF, completion, coach, novelty (src/rebar/llm/plan_review/__init__.py:153 and src/rebar/llm/evals/eval_solver.py:157), contradiction (src/rebar/llm/plan_review/xcheck.py:200), and comment-trail (xcheck.py:338) — none of these templates is restructured, so the else branch handles them with no caller change; __init__.py, eval_solver.py, and xcheck.py are AUDITED, no change). `plan_review_finder.md` drops its trailing "# Plan under review …\n{{plan}}" block (stance-only template; no marker added — the prefix boundary is explicit in code). Container/ISF/completion/coach templates are NOT restructured (their `{{plan}}` stays at the template bottom; separate prompt_ids and cache entries). The directive lives in the preamble, so it reaches EVERY Pass-1 request (finder chunks, container, ISF) and, by byte-identity, the verifier prefix too, where its "when surfacing findings" phrasing is inert.
(3) **Verifier templates**: both `plan_review_verifier.md` and `plan_review_verifier_agentic.md` begin their body with a `{{shared_prefix}}` line followed by the existing stance text unchanged, and DELETE the trailing `<!--volatile-->` + "# Plan under review …\n{{plan}}" block entirely. With no marker left, `split_volatile` takes its no-marker path (prompts.py:361-363): the WHOLE rendered template is the stable system prompt and `instructions` = `base_instructions` (the per-chunk finding listing stays user-turn — unchanged mechanism). Neither verifier declares front-matter `variables:`, so the contract change is exactly "used var `plan` → used var `shared_prefix`" under the legacy strict path; no parity-gate front-matter edit is needed.
(4) **How `shared_prefix` reaches the live variable map — the exact seam**: `plan_review_verify_inputs` (workflow_ops.py:363) returns `{"shared_prefix": prompts.shared_plan_prefix(pctx.plan_text), "instructions": [...]}` — its `plan` output key is REMOVED (its ONLY consumers are the two verify `with:` lines being replaced, plan-review.yaml:182 and :293; the prerequisite step at yaml:149 reads a DIFFERENT step, `plan_review_prerequisite_verify_inputs`, untouched); `src/rebar/schemas/plan_review_verify_inputs_output.schema.json` (`additionalProperties: false`) correspondingly drops the `plan` property, adds `shared_prefix` (string, required), and its top-level + per-property descriptions are rewritten to name `{{shared_prefix}}` (no stale `{{plan}}` text remains); and BOTH verify steps in `src/rebar/llm/workflow/gates/plan-review.yaml` (the agentic arm's `verify` at line ~177 and the single-turn arm's at line ~288) replace `plan: ${{ steps.verify_inputs.outputs.plan }}` with `shared_prefix: ${{ steps.verify_inputs.outputs.shared_prefix }}` in their `with:` blocks. `runs.py` needs NO edit: `RunnerAgentStep` already merges every string-valued `with:` input into the render variables (runs.py:204-207), so `shared_prefix` flows to `resolve_prompt_cached` through the existing generic mechanism — runs.py is an AUDITED consumer with zero changes.
(5) **Every renderer of the verifier templates, enumerated**: (a) `RunnerAgentStep` — covered by (4); (b) `fidelity_spot_eval.py` — `plan-review-verifier` is REMOVED from `RELOCATED_PROMPTS` (fidelity_spot_eval.py:46-54, comment updated): the verifiers no longer carry the split marker so they are no longer "relocated" prompts, `test_relocated_prompts_all_carry_the_split_marker` (tests/unit/test_fidelity_spot_eval.py) then passes over the remaining entries, and no committed corpus renders a verifier (`RELOCATED_PROMPTS`/`relocation_spot_eval` have no consumers outside the module + that test; the unit-test corpus uses `completion-verifier` only), so `_relocation_requests` never sees `{{shared_prefix}}` and needs no change; (c) `passes._resolve_system` — supplies both variables per (2) (live code never calls it with the verifier ids; the bespoke pass2 was retired in epic solid-timer-unison WS1); (d) direct test renderers, each updated to supply `shared_prefix` (or drop `plan`): tests/unit/test_prompt_cache_split.py (THREE updates: remove the two verifier ids from `_MARKED_PROMPTS`; rewrite `test_bespoke_plan_review_path_strips_marker_and_keeps_plan_in_system` to the finder prefix invariant with this exact contract — `sys_prompt = passes._resolve_system(passes.PASS_FINDER, "PLAN-XYZ-marker-test", cfg); assert sys_prompt.startswith(prompts.shared_plan_prefix("PLAN-XYZ-marker-test")); assert "PLAN-XYZ-marker-test" in sys_prompt; assert prompts.VOLATILE_MARKER not in sys_prompt`; and rewrite `test_verify_step_prefix_is_byte_stable_across_plans` (tests/unit/test_prompt_cache_split.py:177-196) to supply `"shared_prefix": prompts.shared_plan_prefix("PLAN-ALPHA-aaa")` (resp. BETA) in place of `"plan"` and INVERT its expectations to the new contract — each verifier system prompt now CONTAINS its plan (`"PLAN-ALPHA-aaa" in r1.system_prompt`), the two system prompts DIFFER (`r1.system_prompt != r2.system_prompt`), each starts with its own `shared_plan_prefix`, and `instructions` carries only the base_instructions since the volatile body is gone), tests/unit/test_reviewer_prompt_hygiene.py (`test_resolve_system_preamble`, tests/unit/test_reviewer_prompt_hygiene.py:80-97: REMOVE `passes.PASS_VERIFIER` from the loop — no live bespoke verifier caller exists post-solid-timer-unison WS1, and keeping it would render a doubled preamble (the `_resolve_system` prepend PLUS the preamble embedded in the template's `{{shared_prefix}}`); the remaining ids keep asserting the stance leads the plan body), tests/unit/workflow/test_plan_review_live_plumbing.py (`test_runner_agent_step_resolves_plan_for_verify`: the StepContext inputs replace `"plan": "..."` with `"shared_prefix": prompts.shared_plan_prefix("## Plan\nBuild X in src/x.py.")`; the coach variant of the test is unchanged — the coach template keeps `{{plan}}`), tests/unit/workflow/test_plan_review_verify_recovery.py (`_verify_ctx`, tests/unit/workflow/test_plan_review_verify_recovery.py:47-62: its hard-coded `"plan": "## Plan\nBuild X in src/x.py."` input becomes `"shared_prefix": prompts.shared_plan_prefix("## Plan\nBuild X in src/x.py.")`), tests/unit/test_llm_temperature.py (the `plan-review-verifier` StepContext inputs: `"plan": "P"` becomes `"shared_prefix": prompts.shared_plan_prefix("P")`), tests/external/test_review_kernel_rules_live.py:74-79 (the render call becomes `prompts.resolve_prompt(prompt, {"shared_prefix": prompts.shared_plan_prefix(context)}, repo_root=cfg.repo_path)` — `plan` dropped from the variables dict; the adjacent `strip_volatile_marker` call becomes a harmless no-op and may stay). The `plan-review-verifier.eval.yaml` standing spec references the prompt id but never renders the template offline (tests/unit/test_plan_review_evals.py validates spec structure only). (e) CONTRIBUTING.md:620 names `_SHARED_PREAMBLE` — updated to `SHARED_STANCE_PREAMBLE`/`shared_plan_prefix` in prompts.py, and the same paragraph gains two invariant sentences for future contributors: the preamble/prefix is single-sourced in prompts.py (never re-inline it in a template), and the verifier templates must not re-introduce a `{{plan}}` variable or a volatile marker (test_shared_prefix.py is the canary).
(6) **Pass-1 warm gate measures the ACTUAL prefix**: the finder warm-then-fan-out gate currently tests `det_floor.est_tokens(plan) >= CACHE_MIN_PREFIX_TOKENS` (pass1.py:494-498), but after this change the cached bytes are `shared_plan_prefix(plan)` (larger by the preamble + heading). pass1.py gains a tiny helper `def _prefix_tokens(plan: str) -> int: return det_floor.est_tokens(prompts.shared_plan_prefix(plan))` and the gate condition becomes `_prefix_tokens(plan) >= CACHE_MIN_PREFIX_TOKENS` — consistent with the bytes actually sent. The CONTAINER warm gate (`parent_tokens >= CACHE_MIN_PREFIX_TOKENS`, pass1.py:222) is deliberately untouched: the container prompt is not restructured in this change and `parent_tokens` also feeds bin-packing sizing (pass1.py:200-207), which must keep measuring the plan alone. `CACHE_MIN_PREFIX_TOKENS` itself (pass1.py:49) is unchanged.
(7) **No verdict/TTL change**: verify stays per-chunk with merge-by-index; temperature/budget `with:` inputs untouched; no TTL change. Alternatives rejected: raising cache TTL to 1h (pass gaps of 50-100ms never approach the 5-minute refresh-on-hit window; revise loops change the prefix bytes, so the 2x write premium buys nothing); padding the preamble itself past the 4096-token floor without moving the plan (a >4096-token boilerplate preamble adds that many tokens of pure overhead to every call, while the plan bytes are ALREADY sent per pass — making them the cached prefix costs nothing extra).

## Scope
src/rebar/llm/prompting/prompts.py (SHARED_STANCE_PREAMBLE + shared_plan_prefix), src/rebar/llm/plan_review/passes.py (delete _SHARED_PREAMBLE; _resolve_system branch + variables), src/rebar/llm/reviewers/plan_review_finder.md (drop trailing plan block), src/rebar/llm/reviewers/plan_review_verifier.md and plan_review_verifier_agentic.md ({{shared_prefix}} head; delete volatile tail), src/rebar/llm/plan_review/workflow_ops.py (verify_inputs emits shared_prefix), src/rebar/schemas/plan_review_verify_inputs_output.schema.json (add shared_prefix), src/rebar/llm/workflow/gates/plan-review.yaml (both verify `with:` blocks), src/rebar/llm/plan_review/pass1.py (finder warm gate measures shared_plan_prefix via _prefix_tokens), src/rebar/llm/plan_review/fidelity_spot_eval.py (RELOCATED_PROMPTS minus plan-review-verifier), CONTRIBUTING.md (stale symbol reference + invariant sentences), tests/unit/workflow/test_shared_prefix.py (new), tests/unit/test_prompt_cache_split.py, tests/unit/test_reviewer_prompt_hygiene.py, tests/unit/workflow/test_plan_review_live_plumbing.py, tests/unit/workflow/test_plan_review_verify_recovery.py, tests/unit/test_llm_temperature.py, tests/external/test_review_kernel_rules_live.py (updated renderers per Approach 5d). Audited, no change: src/rebar/llm/workflow/runs.py (generic string `with:`-merge at runs.py:204-207 already carries shared_prefix), src/rebar/llm/plan_review/__init__.py, src/rebar/llm/plan_review/xcheck.py, src/rebar/llm/evals/eval_solver.py (else-branch `_resolve_system` callers, no signature change).

## Testing
New tests/unit/workflow/test_shared_prefix.py (offline, FakeRunner/no model), against a named in-file fixture plan `FIXTURE_PLAN` built programmatically to exceed the cache floor (the test_pass1_warmup.py:88 approach): (1) `passes._resolve_system(passes.PASS_FINDER, FIXTURE_PLAN, cfg)` and the `resolve_prompt_cached` stable segment of BOTH verifier prompts (rendered with `shared_prefix=prompts.shared_plan_prefix(FIXTURE_PLAN)`) each `startswith(prompts.shared_plan_prefix(FIXTURE_PLAN))` byte-for-byte, and that prefix contains the full plan text; (2) `det_floor.est_tokens(shared_plan_prefix(FIXTURE_PLAN)) >= pass1.CACHE_MIN_PREFIX_TOKENS` (the imported constant — currently 4096 — so a future floor change re-verifies automatically); (3) the exhaustiveness directive is in `SHARED_STANCE_PREAMBLE` and hence in `_resolve_system` output for PASS_FINDER, PASS_CONTAINER, and PASS_ISF (every Pass-1 entry point); (4) a sentinel finding listing passed as `base_instructions` appears in the returned `instructions` and NOT in the stable system segment, for both verifiers; (5) `not hasattr(passes, "_SHARED_PREAMBLE")`; (6) rendering the verifier prompts through `RunnerAgentStep` with a StepContext whose inputs mirror the yaml `with:` (findings/instructions/shared_prefix) succeeds; (7) the warm gate boundary: a plan built so that `det_floor.est_tokens(plan) < CACHE_MIN_PREFIX_TOKENS <= pass1._prefix_tokens(plan)` proves the gate measures the prefix actually sent (est_tokens is deterministic chars-based, so the boundary plan is constructible); (8) `_resolve_system` output for a non-restructured pass starts with `SHARED_STANCE_PREAMBLE` exactly once (no doubled preamble). Updated existing tests as enumerated in Approach (5d); tests/external is the opt-in live suite (not a CI gate) — the ACs use offline structural proxies, consistent with the standing eval posture. Regression: `pytest tests/unit/workflow/` then the full `tests/unit` suite; tests/unit/workflow/test_plan_review_workflow.py (full-yaml fixture runs) and tests/unit/workflow/test_pass1_warmup.py pass UNMODIFIED — verdict and warm behavior unchanged for existing fixtures (the gate change only widens the warm condition by the constant-size preamble).

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] For the named fixture plan, the Pass-1 finder system prompt and the rendered stable segments of BOTH verifier prompts each begin byte-for-byte with `prompts.shared_plan_prefix(plan)`, which contains the full plan material (checked: `pytest tests/unit/workflow/test_shared_prefix.py`).
- [ ] `det_floor.est_tokens(shared_plan_prefix(FIXTURE_PLAN))` >= `pass1.CACHE_MIN_PREFIX_TOKENS` (asserted against the imported constant, currently 4096 — pass1.py:49) (checked: `pytest tests/unit/workflow/test_shared_prefix.py`).
- [ ] The reviewing-stance preamble text exists ONCE, as `prompts.SHARED_STANCE_PREAMBLE`, and `passes._SHARED_PREAMBLE` is removed (checked: unit test asserting `not hasattr(passes, "_SHARED_PREAMBLE")` and that `_resolve_system` output for a non-restructured pass starts with `SHARED_STANCE_PREAMBLE`).
- [ ] The exhaustiveness directive is a bullet of `SHARED_STANCE_PREAMBLE` and present in the `_resolve_system` system prompt of every Pass-1 entry point (PASS_FINDER, PASS_CONTAINER, PASS_ISF) (checked: unit test in test_shared_prefix.py).
- [ ] The per-run finding listing remains user-turn (`base_instructions` → `instructions`) and is absent from every rendered stable system segment (checked: unit test in test_shared_prefix.py).
- [ ] `plan-review-verifier` is removed from `RELOCATED_PROMPTS` and every remaining entry still carries the volatile marker (checked: `pytest tests/unit/test_fidelity_spot_eval.py::test_relocated_prompts_all_carry_the_split_marker` with the updated tuple).
- [ ] Both plan-review.yaml verify steps supply `shared_prefix` from `verify_inputs` outputs and the live render path resolves without PromptError (checked: unit test rendering via RunnerAgentStep with yaml-shaped inputs; `pytest tests/unit/workflow/test_plan_review_workflow.py` full-yaml runs).
- [ ] Review verdict behavior on the existing workflow fixtures is unchanged (checked: tests/unit/workflow/test_plan_review_workflow.py passes unmodified).
- [ ] The Pass-1 finder warm gate measures the actual prefix: for a boundary plan with `est_tokens(plan) < CACHE_MIN_PREFIX_TOKENS <= pass1._prefix_tokens(plan)` the warm condition holds (checked: unit test in test_shared_prefix.py), and existing warm behavior is unchanged (checked: tests/unit/workflow/test_pass1_warmup.py passes unmodified).
- [ ] `plan_review_verify_inputs` no longer emits a `plan` output and its output schema names `shared_prefix` with no stale `{{plan}}` description text (checked: unit assertion on the step's returned keys + `grep -c '{{plan}}' src/rebar/schemas/plan_review_verify_inputs_output.schema.json` returns 0).
- [ ] CONTRIBUTING.md no longer references `_SHARED_PREAMBLE` and names the new single source (checked: `grep -c _SHARED_PREAMBLE CONTRIBUTING.md` returns 0 and `grep -c SHARED_STANCE_PREAMBLE CONTRIBUTING.md` returns >= 1).
